name: PalPanelServerMods
description: Server-only Community-Raid build. Arena v2 step 5 remains inactive until the first verified hit on the exact spawned raid boss. At that moment the boss's live world position becomes the arena center without teleporting the NPC, online players are placed on a compact 450-unit safe ring, and one second later a persistent BP_LevelObject_TowerLockBarrier_C appears at 5.0x horizontal / 2.2x vertical scale with authoritative replicated bLocked=true. Actor collision on the visual barrier is disabled once on the server; the 3000-unit player keep-in remains the authoritative raid boundary. No repeated component visibility/replication mutation, custom RPC, Niagara call or AI mutation is used. No client installation required.
